message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I've confirmed that Elena's appointment on Thursday at 10:00 AM is a "Hiring panel". I'll pass this information to Alison. It's not as easily movable as "Travel" or "Busy", but it's also not as rigid as a court appearance. This might be our only shot.

Since we're running out of options, I'll also suggest that we have a fallback plan in case this doesn't work. We could look for slots where only one person is busy and the appointment type is something that seems flexible. I already identified another one: Thursday at 14:30, when only Marcus Hale is busy. Alison can check what his conflict is at that time.

This way, we're not putting all our eggs in one basket.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
